title: Deadly Serpentine Scandal
story: In the opulent world of high society, the Bellingham Ball was the talk of the town. A lavish gathering took place at the exquisite estate of the Vanderbilt family, where the air was thick with intrigue and enchantment. The host, Sir Reginald Vanderbilt, had invited numerous high-profile figures under one roof. The night was envisioned to be a success, but a chilling twist would reveal itself in the morning.
victim: The victim, Leonora Dupont, a renowned botanist.
crimeScene: The opulent ballroom of the Vanderbilt estate, where the late night revelry was in full swing.
forensicClue: An unexpected cyanide residue was discovered on the late victim's reticule.
question: Who is the culprit and how did the detective solve it?
